Changes.note: The note you add stays with this celse and only you see it; the course team does not. While you are enrolled and the course is open you can rewrite it, and you can delete it at any time; a deleted note does not come back.
LessonNotes.deleteFailed: The note could not be deleted. Try again in a moment.
LessonNotes.empty: You have no notes on this session yet.
LessonNotes.forbidden: You need to be enrolled in the course to write notes.
LessonNotes.loadFailed: Your notes could not be loaded.
LessonNotes.saveFailed: The note could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
LessonNotes.timeHelpSession: Optional: type the time since the session began.
LessonNotes.title: My notes
